A.depoimento: I sent two knights to take Santarem, and a knight with an archer to take Evora, while starting the production of an archer in the capital to strengthen my army.
A.plano: Capture Santarem and Evora to expand. From Santarem, push to Coimbra and Badajoz. From Evora, push to Faro. Build archers and spearmen in Lisboa to reinforce the fronts.

B.depoimento: Our armies march on Tarragona to claim it for the crown. In Barcelona, the blacksmiths work day and night, forging 2 new spearmen to defend our capital and prepare for the next wave of conquest.
B.plano: Capture the neutral village Tarragona to expand our territory and secure a second village. Build 2 spearmen in Barcelona to reinforce our capital and maintain troop production. Next turn, we will assess the situation in Tarragona and plan our next expansion towards Girona or further inland.

B.depoimento: We marched on Zaragoza with an archer-led army to exploit the counter triangle, expecting a decisive victory. Barcelona's forges produced fresh spearmen, and we dispatched one to bolster Tarragona's defenses. Our western expansion has begun.
B.plano: ATTACK Zaragoza with archers to counter their spearmen and minimize losses. Build 2 spearman in Barcelona, send 1 to reinforce Tarragona. NEXT TURN: assess the battle, reinforce Zaragoza's garrison, and consider attacking Castellon or Girona. Do NOT attack Girona yet—our forces there are too weak.

A.depoimento: I have ordered my armies to strike at the neutral villages of Coimbra, Faro, and Badajoz. My knights will take Coimbra, while my archers and spearmen will fall upon Faro and Badajoz. We will expand our kingdom's borders!
A.plano: Expand west and south. Take Coimbra, Faro, Badajoz this turn. Next turn, push north to Porto and Salamanca, then east to Madrid and Toledo. Build archers and knights for fast expansion. Aim to capture 18 villages quickly.

B.depoimento: Orders are given to conquer three neutral villages simultaneously: Castellon, Girona, and Huesca. Our spearman march on Castellon while the knight from Tarragona rides to Girona through Barcelona. Zaragoza's elite forces strike Huesca. We reinforce Tarragona with Barcelona's spearman and build a knight in our capital and an archer in Tarragona to prepare for the next wave of expansion.
B.plano: We are expanding to the north and east to secure Girona, Castellon, and Huesca. Tarragona sends 4 spearman to Castellon and 1 knight to Girona (via Barcelona). Zaragoza sends 2 knight and 2 spearman to Huesca. Barcelona sends 3 spearman to reinforce Tarragona. Build 1 knight in Barcelona and 1 archer in Tarragona. Next turn, assess the conquests and prepare to push towards Madrid or Teruel.

A.depoimento: My armies have conquered Coimbra and Faro. Now, the march on Badajoz and Porto begins, while I strengthen my hold on the frontier villages for the next phase of the campaign.
A.plano: This turn, my marching troops take Badajoz, while my Coimbra knights capture Porto. I reinforce my front lines to prepare for the next push: Santarem and Evora get reinforcements to support attacks on Salamanca and Sevilha next turn. After taking Salamanca, I'll expand east toward Madrid and Toledo, aiming to reach 18 villages quickly.

A.depoimento: In a brilliant move, my Badajoz forces captured Toledo by using archers to counter its spearmen. Meanwhile, a strong army from Santarem marches on Salamanca, and I begin the reinforcement of Faro for the upcoming assault on Sevilha. My troops are on the move, and my economy is growing as I build new units.
A.plano: This turn I take Toledo with a counter force from Badajoz. I send Santarem's army to Salamanca to capture it next turn. I reinforce Faro with Evora's troops to prepare for an attack on Sevilha. I also send Porto's knight to Coimbra and Lisboa's archer to Santarem to strengthen my interior. I build archers and knights to grow my forces. Next turn I will attack Sevilha from Faro and push east from Salamanca.

B.depoimento: We are launching a coordinated strike to capture Madrid with our archers, while reinforcing Castellon and Zaragoza for the next phase of our expansion towards Valencia. Our economy is growing, and our army is ready to strike.
B.plano: Capture Madrid with 4 archers from Zaragoza. Send 3 spearman from Tarragona to Castellon and 1 knight from Huesca to Zaragoza to prepare for the next wave of attacks on Valencia and other neutral villages. Build troops across all villages to maximize growth.

A.depoimento: My armies are on the move on all fronts. Salamanca is taken by Santarem's forces, opening the path to Madrid. Sevilha is attacked from Faro, while Toledo is reinforced with spearmen for the assault on Cordoba. The interior is being strengthened as I build up my knight and archer cores. The enemy is being pushed back on every front.
A.plano: Salamanca falls to Santarem's army this turn; I reinforce it with Coimbra's troops to hold the new front. Faro strikes Sevilha, supported by Evora's knight arriving next turn. Badajoz sends its spearmen to Toledo to prepare for Cordoba. Lisboa and Santarem reinforce the interior. I build knights and archers across all villages. Next turn, I will attack Madrid from Salamanca and Cordoba from Toledo, expanding on both fronts towards the enemy.

B.depoimento: Ordered the assault on Valencia and Teruel to expand my territory. Castellon's spearmen and Zaragoza's mixed force are on the march. I am building troops across all my villages to replenish losses and grow my army for the next push.
B.plano: Capture Valencia with 8 spearmen from Castellon and Teruel with 1 knight and 2 archers from Zaragoza. Build troops in all villages to grow the army. Keep an eye on Salamanca as the enemy is marching there.

B.depoimento: We have consolidated our hold on Valencia and Teruel. Now, we must build up our forces and reinforce our borders. I am sending troops from the interior to the key hubs of Madrid, Zaragoza, and Teruel. We will build spearman and knights in our productive villages to grow our army, preparing for a push into Salamanca and Toledo next turn.
B.plano: Reinforce Madrid with Zaragoza's knight and archer. Build troops in all capable villages (2 spearman in Barcelona, Castellon, Zaragoza, Madrid; 1 knight in Tarragona, Girona, Huesca). Send Tarragona's archers and knight to Zaragoza, and Barcelona's knights to Tarragona to build a southern army. Prepare to attack Salamanca next turn with Madrid's reinforced garrison.

A.depoimento: We launch a bold double offensive! Our spearmen and archers from Toledo march on Cordoba, relying on the spearman-knight counter to crush the neutral knights. Simultaneously, we gather our knights at the front lines: Salamanca, Toledo, and Porto are reinforced to strike Madrid, Teruel, and Vigo in the coming days. The rear villages work tirelessly to feed our war machine. The tide of the war is turning in our favor!
A.plano: We launch a massive multi-pronged expansion. This turn, we attack the neutral Cordoba with our Toledo garrison (spearman/archers), exploiting the spearman-knight counter triangle to win. We simultaneously reinforce Salamanca with a knight from Coimbra to prepare a 3-knight attack on Madrid next turn. We also concentrate knights at Toledo (from Badajoz, Faro, Sevilha) to launch a 3-knight attack on the weak Teruel next turn. Porto is reinforced by Lisboa's knight to prepare a 2-knight attack on Vigo next turn. Rear villages build archers and knights to sustain the offensive. Next turn, we will

B.depoimento: I focused on building up my forces, sending Zaragoza's fast troops to capture the neutral village of Pamplona, while reinforcing my border villages Madrid and Teruel against potential enemy attacks. I also moved troops around to strengthen my interior.
B.plano: Build knights in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Zaragoza, Madrid; archers in Huesca, Valencia; spearmen in Teruel. Send Zaragoza's 4 archers + 1 knight to capture Pamplona (arrives next turn). Reinforce Madrid with Zaragoza's 3 spearmen and Huesca's 1 knight. Reinforce Teruel with Valencia's 3 spearmen. Move Tarragona's 4 knights to Zaragoza, Barcelona's 1 spear to Tarragona, Castellon's 1 spear to Valencia. Keep Madrid and Teruel garrisons for defense. Expect enemy may attack Teruel; hope reinforcements arrive in time. Next turn: assess border, plan major attack from Madrid on Salam

A.depoimento: I am mobilizing my troops to strike at the enemy's borders. Porto and Coimbra are reinforcing Salamanca for an assault on Madrid, while Badajoz and Sevilha are converging on Cordoba to launch an attack on Murcia. My villages are busy producing archers and knights to sustain the campaign.
A.plano: Gather forces at Salamanca to take Madrid, and at Cordoba to take Murcia. Build up troops in all villages for future expansion.

B.depoimento: I am building knights across all my villages to assemble a massive cavalry army. I am sending all available knights to Madrid and Teruel to prepare for the attack on Toledo next turn. I am also sending infantry and archers from Valencia to reinforce Teruel. By consolidating my forces, I aim to overwhelm the enemy at Toledo and open up the southern part of the map.
B.plano: Focus on taking Toledo (8) next turn. Build knights in all villages to maximize cavalry production. Send all available knights to Madrid (12) and Teruel (13) to consolidate forces at the border. Send spearman and archer from Valencia (16) to Teruel (13) to reinforce its garrison. Do not attack this turn; wait until the massive knight army is assembled to attack Toledo with overwhelming forces and minimal losses.

A.depoimento: I am attacking Murcia with my full force from Cordoba and reinforcing Porto for the attack on Vigo. I am building archers in my border villages to swell my ranks.
A.plano: Capture Murcia and Vigo to expand. Reinforce Porto and Cordoba. Build archers on the front lines. Prepare to attack Madrid and Teruel next turns.

B.depoimento: This turn, I focused on expanding my territory and military strength. I ordered the construction of knights and archers in all my villages to rapidly grow my forces. I sent a strong, balanced army from Madrid to capture the neutral village of Burgos, aiming to secure a new source of resources and territory. Additionally, I dispatched knights from Castellon to Valencia to reinforce our southern flank, preparing for the assault on Murcia.
B.plano: Focus on expanding territory by capturing neutral villages to reach the 18-village threshold. Attacking Burgos with a balanced stack from Madrid to secure a new village and resource node. Reinforcing Valencia from Castellon to prepare for the capture of Murcia next turn. Maximizing knight production across all villages to build a highly mobile, powerful army.

B.depoimento: King B orders a massive offensive on all fronts! Armies from Madrid, Valencia, Teruel, and Burgos march to conquer Salamanca, Murcia, Toledo, and Vigo. The goal is to secure 15 villages by the end of this turn and pave the way for the final push to 18.
B.plano: Launch a massive four-front offensive to capture Vigo, Murcia, Toledo, and Salamanca, expanding to 15 villages. Next turn, explore the newly revealed Cordoba, Badajoz, and Porto, then attack them to reach the 18-village threshold. Reinforce Madrid and Valencia with troops from Zaragoza and the newly built units.

A.depoimento:
We launched attacks on Madrid and Vigo this turn, hoping to expand our territory.
We also sent reinforcements to Badajoz and built a large number of spearmen across our empire to prepare for the next offensives.
A.plano: Build spearmen to counter enemy knights. Attack Madrid and Vigo this turn to gain villages. Next turn, push on Toledo from Badajoz and Madrid, and Murcia from Cordoba. Continue moving spearmen to the front lines.

B.depoimento: Our forces strike at Badajoz and Cordoba, while Madrid receives Zaragoza's might. The interior sends troops to the borders to hold the line. We build in every village, ready for the next push.
B.plano: Turn 16: Attack Badajoz (Toledo) and Cordoba (Murcia) with all troops. Send Zaragoza's entire garrison to Madrid. Reinforce borders: Burgos to Vigo, Huesca to Zaragoza, Pamplona to Burgos, Teruel to Toledo, Valencia to Murcia. Build troops in all villages to replenish. Next turn, explore new villages from Badajoz/Cordoba, then target Porto and Salamanca.

A.depoimento: I am ordering a full-scale assault on the enemy's front line. My armies are attacking Toledo, Madrid, and Murcia simultaneously to overwhelm their defenses. Reinforcements are marching from the interior to hold the line and prepare for the next push. This strike will secure my borders and bring me closer to victory.
A.plano: Launch a triple attack on Toledo, Madrid, and Murcia this turn to break the enemy line. Send all troops from Badajoz, Salamanca, and Cordoba. Reinforce these villages from the interior for the next turn. Once these three enemy villages fall, my front line will be secured, and I can push deeper into enemy territory towards Zaragoza and Valencia. Continue building spearman to counter enemy knights.

B.depoimento: I am setting up a massive offensive on Vigo by swapping troops from Madrid and Pamplona into Burgos, while reinforcing Madrid with Toledo's garrison and Toledo with Teruel's. I am also building troops across all my villages to grow my army for the next phase of the campaign.
B.plano: Focus on conquering Vigo. Sent Pamplona and Madrid troops to Burgos, Toledo to Madrid, Teruel to Toledo to swap and defend. Build troops everywhere. Next turn, attack Vigo from Burgos with the massive army that will have arrived. Keep an eye on Salamanca and Cordoba.

A.depoimento: This turn, I am launching a decisive strike on Teruel from Toledo to secure the northern front. I am reinforcing Madrid from Salamanca to repel the incoming enemy army, while Badajoz and Cordoba send troops to reinforce Toledo and Murcia for the next phase of the campaign. My goal is to reach 18 villages and secure the victory.
A.plano: Launch a triple attack this turn: Toledo to Teruel, Salamanca to Madrid (defense), Badajoz and Cordoba to reinforce Toledo and Murcia. Next turn, attack Valencia from Murcia and push towards Zaragoza. Continue building spearman to counter enemy knights and maintain the front line.

B.depoimento: We struck at Vigo with a knight vanguard, exploiting the enemy's archer weakness. Our borders are reinforced: Castellon, Valencia, Zaragoza, and Tarragona received reinforcements. Builders across the realm produced knights and archers, swelling our ranks for the next push.
B.plano: Attack Vigo from Burgos with 5 knights, 3 archers, 1 spear to counter archers. Reinforce Castellon from Tarragona (2s,3a,2k), Valencia from Castellon (1s,1a,1k), Zaragoza from Huesca (2s,2a,1k), Tarragona from Barcelona (1s,2a,1k). Build knights at Girona, Castellon, Huesca, Valencia, Burgos; knights+archers at others. Hold remaining villages.

A.depoimento:
Built 26 knights and 4 spear across the realm.
Sent spearman to reinforce Porto, Teruel, and Murcia.
Attacked Valencia with 8 archers and 4 knights from Teruel.
Preparing for a major push next turn.
A.plano: My campaign aims to capture Vigo and Valencia next turn by concentrating forces at Porto and Teruel. I have built knights across the realm to counter the enemy's archers. After taking these villages, I will push on Burgos and Zaragoza from Madrid and the newly captured territories, seeking to hold 18 villages for two turns.

A.depoimento: Your Majesty's armies have struck with great coordination this turn. Porto's spear legions have overwhelmed Vigo, while Teruel's forces have crushed Castellon's defenders. In Madrid, a brilliant tactical maneuver has seen the infantry withdrawn to Salamanca while knights rode in from all directions, transforming the capital's defense into an impenetrable knight fortress. Next turn, the gathered knights will launch a devastating assault on Zaragoza, carrying us to 18 villages and the threshold of total dominance!
A.plano: This turn, I will conquer Vigo from Porto and Castellon from Teruel, bringing my total to 17 villages. I will simultaneously reposition Madrid's defense by sending its spearman to Salamanca and bringing knights from Salamanca and Toledo, making Madrid a knight-heavy fortress to deter Burgos. I will also gather knights in Teruel from Valencia and Toledo to prepare a decisive knight strike on Zaragoza next turn, which will bring my total to 18 villages and secure the victory condition.

A.depoimento: The spearmen of Teruel march on Castellon while the knights of Madrid assemble for the strike on Zaragoza. Two villages from victory, one turn away.
A.plano: Castellon falls this turn to our Teruel spearman (17 villages). Madrid gathers knights from Salamanca and Toledo; next turn we send a knight strike to Zaragoza to reach 18 villages and win. Reinforce Castellon from Valencia and Murcia to hold it.

B.depoimento: This turn, I ordered a full assault on [10] Vigo from [14] Burgos, leveraging the archer counter against their spearmen to secure a key victory. To protect my eastern border, I marched reinforcements from [21] Tarragona and [17] Zaragoza to [18] Castellon, bolstering its garrison against the incoming enemy force. I also relocated the troops from [19] Pamplona to [14] Burgos to maintain a defensive presence there. Across all my villages, I focused on building archers to strengthen my spearman-hunting capabilities.
B.plano: I am focusing on conquering [10] Vigo this turn using all available troops from [14] Burgos, as the math shows a solid victory (69 vs 55 effective force). At the same time, I am reinforcing [18] Castellon from [21] Tarragona and [17] Zaragoza to defend against the incoming enemy army. I am also moving the garrison of [19] Pamplona to [14] Burgos to keep it garrisoned after the attack. I am building archers in all my villages to increase my spearman-countering attack power.

B.depoimento: This turn, I launched a powerful assault on the enemy village of Valencia from Castellon, leveraging my archer advantage against their spearmen. I also reinforced my western front by sending troops from Burgos to Vigo, preparing for the next push into Porto. My economy is strong, and I am building a balanced army of archers, knights, and spearmen across all my villages to secure my borders and expand my territory.
B.plano: I am attacking [16] Valencia from [18] Castellon with a strong archer-heavy force to exploit the enemy's spearman garrison. I am leaving a garrison of 12 troops in Castellon to defend against counter-attacks. I am also sending reinforcements from [14] Burgos to [10] Vigo to prepare for an attack on [6] Porto next turn. I am building archers and knights in all my villages to grow my army.

A.depoimento: King A orders a precise strike on Burgos with his elite knights, exploiting the enemy's weak defense. This victory will trap the garrison in Vigo and secure our northern flank. All villages are ordered to produce knights to sustain the momentum of the campaign.
A.plano: Capture Burgos with Madrid's knights to surround Vigo and open the northern front. Build knights in all villages to rebuild the army. Next turn, consolidate the north and prepare to strike at Zaragoza and Valencia.

B.depoimento: I have launched a double attack on the weak enemy villages of Murcia and Porto, using archer-heavy armies to counter their spearmen. I have left small garrisons in Valencia and Vigo to protect my borders. My army is growing as I build knights across my empire.
B.plano: Attacking Murcia from Valencia and Porto from Vigo with archer-heavy forces to exploit the enemy's spearman garrisons. Leaving small garrisons in the sending villages to protect them. Building knights in all possible villages to grow my army and replace losses. Next turn, I will assess the results and look to attack Salamanca or Cordoba.

A.depoimento: King A orders a grand simultaneous offensive! From the west, Coimbra's knights strike Porto, while Burgos's cavalry sweeps Vigo. In the south, Cordoba's forces assault Murcia. On the eastern front, Teruel launches a double-pronged attack, sending spearmen to Valencia and knights to Castellon. Reinforcements are already marching to support the front lines. The enemy will be overwhelmed by our coordinated might!
A.plano: My campaign this turn focuses on a massive simultaneous offensive on the southern and western fronts to conquer 5 enemy villages (Porto, Vigo, Valencia, Castellon, Murcia) in a single turn, bringing my total to 18 villages (75% of the map). I will send all available troops from the border villages of Coimbra, Cordoba, Teruel, and Burgos to attack their respective neighbors. To ensure my border villages are not left defenseless, I will send reinforcements from interior villages (Lisboa, Santarem, Salamanca to Coimbra; Sevilha, Toledo to Cordoba; Madrid to Burgos) to arrive on the next turn.
